notes.title: beta-0.0.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Changed the default window mode from Fullscreen to Borderless
[*] Colour themes are now available to be selected via the options menu
[/list]

notes.title: beta-0.0.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the master volume had no affect on the music or effect volume.
[*] Replaced the SFX that would play when revealing a cat with a purr instead of a jingle.
[/list]

notes.title: beta-0.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the screen would turn completely gray when alt-tabbing and zooming at the same time.
[*] Added a new achievement for finding all 50 cats.
[*] Added a new achievement for selecting the clock.
[*] Added a new achievement for saving the crown cat until the very end.
[/list]
